name: delta
description_en: A syntax-highlighting pager for git, diff, grep, rg --json, and blame output
readme_excerpt: Get Started Install it (the package is called "git-delta" in most package managers, but the executable is just delta) and add this to your ~/.gitconfig: Or run: Delta has many features and is very customizable; please see delta -h (short help) or delta --help (full manual), or the online user manual.
